channel.title: Wire — Programming
channel.description: Programming from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Muse Spark Open model now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: Meta's Muse Spark Open is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers. (2 sources: aws, hackernews)

item.title: Why are we even doing all this?
item.description: [This is a guest post by Rikab Gambhir. This blog post was initially written in a different file format and converted using AI. — T.] First, they came for the artists, and I did not speak out… (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Package managers have an integrity problem
item.description: I tested 25 of the most popular package managers to check whether they detect a compromised package repository injecting malicious code into legitimate packages. Only two verified the integrity of every package they downloaded. (2 sources: lobsters, rubyweekly)

item.title: An Israeli firm is sending zero-click spyware through online ads
item.description: An Israeli ad company, called Discover-Tech, is working with spyware companies to deliver hacking software through ads, according to research from Citizen Lab and Confiant. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Online ads weaponised to deliver ‘zero-click’ spyware, researchers say
item.description: Discover-Tech’s Controlium software lets clients mass-profile internet users then covertly hack targets, say researchers at University of Toronto (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Writing stateful effect handlers in EYG
What are you doing this weekend?
item.description: Feel free to tell what you plan on doing this weekend and even ask for help or feedback. Please keep in mind it’s more than OK to do nothing at all too! (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: coopiano: A physically modelled piano synthesizer in C++17
item.description: A physically modelled piano synthesizer in C++17 with offline WAV rendering and live MIDI on macOS. - peterc/coopiano (1 source: lobsters)
